a molecular dynamics simulation using a currently used force field reproduces the experimental structure of a crystalline α-CD hexahydrate within the experimental accuracy.

the experimental positions and orientations of the α- CD atoms and the water molecules in the crystal structure of α-CD hexahydrate are well reproduced by molecular dynamics simulations using a standard force field.

molecular dynamics simulations employing the GROMO force field can reproduce the experimental crystallographic structure of crystalline hexahydrate form I of α-cyclodextin within the experimental accuracy.

the development of an empirical force field for molecular mechanics calculations, which has been tested by comparing the results of a simulation of crystalline cyclodextrin with the corresponding experimental results.
the study of the structural properties of crystalline α-CD hexahydrate by molecular dynamics simulation using the GROMOS force field.
the simulation of the crystalline α-CD hexahydrate structure.

the force field used in the present study, in combination with the GROMOS molecular dynamics program, is suitable for the simulation of α-CD crystals.
